items.message: Guaranteed 5% profit every day! Join my Telegram VIP group for just ₹999.
items.explanation: No one can guarantee profit in the stock market. 5% a day would turn ₹1,000 into crores in a year. That is impossible.

items.message: Sir, I am calling from SEBI. Your demat account will be blocked today. Tell me the OTP to stop it.
items.explanation: SEBI never calls investors to ask for an OTP. Never share an OTP with anyone, even if they say they are from the government.

items.message: Buy XYZ Ltd now! Price will double in 3 days. Inside news. Forward to 10 friends.
items.explanation: This is a 'pump and dump'. Scammers push up the price of a small stock, then sell their own shares when you buy.

items.message: Give us your trading app login. Our expert will trade for you and share 50% of the profit.
items.explanation: Never share your trading login or password. Someone else can empty your account, and you are responsible for every trade.

items.message: Download our app from this link (not on Play Store) to get IPO shares at a special discount.
items.explanation: Fake trading apps show fake profits and steal your money. Use only your registered broker's app from the official app store.

items.message: Congratulations! You won ₹50,000 in our stock contest. Pay ₹2,000 processing fee to claim it.
red_flags: Pay a fee to get money
items.explanation: Real prizes never ask you to pay first. Once you pay the 'fee', the scammer disappears.

items.message: Join our WhatsApp group. Our 'institutional account' lets you buy shares at a lower price than the market.
items.explanation: There is no special account that lets ordinary people buy below the market price. Trade only through a SEBI-registered broker.

items.message: Double your money in 30 days with our stock plan. Only 10 seats left, join fast!
items.explanation: Promises to double money quickly and pressure to act fast are classic scam signs. Real investments never promise this.

items.message: I am the famous TV market expert. Message me privately for my secret stock tips.
items.explanation: Scammers copy photos and videos of famous experts, sometimes using AI. Real experts do not send you secret tips on chat.

items.message: Your KYC is incomplete. Click this link and enter your PAN, Aadhaar and bank PIN now.
items.explanation: No real company asks for your bank PIN. Update KYC only inside your broker's official app or website.

items.message: Send money to this personal UPI ID and we will buy shares for you at a lower price.
red_flags: Pay to a personal UPI ID
items.explanation: Money for shares goes only to your own trading account with a registered broker, never to a person's UPI ID.

items.message: Risk-free F&O strategy with 100% accuracy! Pay ₹5,000 once for lifetime trading calls.
items.explanation: No strategy is 100% accurate or risk-free. F&O is high risk, and most individual traders lose money.

items.message: Our advice is SEBI approved, trust us. You don't need to check any registration number.
items.explanation: Real advisers share their SEBI registration number. You can check it on the SEBI website. Refusing to share it is a big warning sign.

items.message: Your app shows ₹2 lakh profit! To withdraw it, first pay 20% tax to our account.
red_flags: Profit only shown in their app
items.explanation: Fake apps show big fake profits. When you try to withdraw, they ask for 'tax' or 'fees'. Real tax is not paid to an app.

items.message: Get a loan against your shares in 5 minutes. Just send your demat password.
items.explanation: No genuine lender asks for your demat password. With it, a scammer can sell your shares.

items.message: Penny stock ABC will go from ₹2 to ₹100! Buy before the market opens tomorrow!
items.explanation: Very cheap 'penny' stocks are easy to push up and dump. Big promises plus urgency are signs of a pump and dump.

items.message: Get ₹10,000 free trading credit! Just share the OTP we sent to your phone.
items.explanation: An OTP is like a key to your account. Anyone asking for it wants to take your money, not give you money.

items.message: Your mutual fund will lapse today. Pay the renewal amount through this link to keep it.
items.explanation: Mutual fund investments do not lapse like insurance. Check your investments only through official apps or statements.

items.message: We can recover your old trading losses for you. Pay ₹3,000 registration fee to start.
items.explanation: 'Recovery' scams target people who already lost money. Complaints are free: use SEBI SCORES or your broker's grievance desk.

items.message: Earn ₹5,000 a day by liking stock videos. Deposit ₹1,000 first to unlock the tasks.
items.explanation: Task scams pay small amounts at first to win your trust, then ask for bigger deposits and disappear.

items.message: NSE: You bought 5 shares of ABC Ltd today. If this trade was not done by you, report it to your broker.
items.explanation: Exchanges send trade alerts like this so you can spot trades you did not make. It asks for nothing, has no link and no OTP request.

items.message: Your SIP of ₹500 in XYZ Mutual Fund for October was successful. Units will be added to your account.
items.explanation: This is a normal confirmation for a SIP you set up. It asks you to do nothing.

items.message: Bank alert: ₹500 debited for your SIP. Never share your OTP or PIN with anyone.
items.explanation: A normal debit alert with a safety reminder. Real banks tell you never to share OTPs; they don't ask for them.

items.message: An adviser gives you their SEBI registration number. You check it on the SEBI website and it matches.
items.explanation: Checking registration on the SEBI website is exactly the right step. Even then, no adviser can guarantee returns.

items.message: Your monthly demat statement is ready. Open your broker app to view it.
items.explanation: Brokers and depositories send regular statements. It points you to your own app, not to an unknown link.

items.message: IPO update: allotment results are out. You can check your status on the registrar or exchange website.
items.explanation: IPO allotment status is public and is checked on official websites. No payment or OTP is asked for.

items.message: Fund factsheet note: Past returns do not guarantee future returns. Read all scheme documents carefully.
items.explanation: This is a standard, honest warning. Real investment products remind you about risk instead of promising profit.

items.message: Your stop-loss order for 10 shares of ABC Ltd was triggered. Sold at ₹245.
items.explanation: This confirms an order you placed yourself. You can check it in your broker app's order history.

items.message: Your broker: we will never call you for your password or OTP. Report suspicious calls to us.
items.explanation: This is a safety message. It warns you about scams and asks you for nothing.

items.message: Markets will be closed tomorrow for a public holiday. Orders placed today will not carry over.
items.explanation: Exchanges publish a holiday list every year. This is normal information with no request.
